context.report: REDDIT_ADS_GET_A_REPORT: ad_account_id, data.{starts_at,ends_at,fields,breakdowns,filter,time_zone_id}; UTC ISO boundaries aligned with account timezone; breakdown CAMPAIGN/AD_GROUP/AD for scope. B.data.metrics[] has open keys; bind returned keys, paginate literal page.size/page.token.

Spend.text: Request SPEND; bind its actual key in B.data.metrics[] and verify currency/unit before comparison (no declared unit).

Impressions.text: Request IMPRESSIONS; bind actual B.data.metrics[] key; count.

_clicks.text: Request CLICKS; bind actual B.data.metrics[] key and click definition; not automatically all/link equivalents.

CTR.text: 100 × _clicks / Impressions; percentage points only when all-click definition matches.

CTR (Link clicks).text: 100 × _clicks / Impressions only when the returned click definition matches link clicks; otherwise unknown.

CPC (Link).text: Spend / _clicks only for verified link clicks; currency/click after unit verification.

CPM.text: 1000 × Spend / Impressions; currency/1000 impressions after unit verification.

Purchases.text: CONVERSIONS is mixed; no fixed event-specific returned key for Purchases in this contract. Verify the exact event/count key and attribution in the relevant report section or supplied export; unresolved count stays unknown.

Website purchases.text: CONVERSIONS is mixed; no fixed event-specific returned key for Website purchases in this contract. Verify the exact event/count key and attribution in the relevant report section or supplied export; unresolved count stays unknown.

Leads.text: CONVERSIONS is mixed; no fixed event-specific returned key for Leads in this contract. Verify the exact event/count key and attribution in the relevant report section or supplied export; unresolved count stays unknown.

Mobile app purchases.text: CONVERSIONS is mixed; no fixed event-specific returned key for Mobile app purchases in this contract. Verify the exact event/count key and attribution in the relevant report section or supplied export; unresolved count stays unknown.

Mobile app installs.text: CONVERSIONS is mixed; no fixed event-specific returned key for Mobile app installs in this contract. Verify the exact event/count key and attribution in the relevant report section or supplied export; unresolved count stays unknown.

Cost per mobile app purchase.text: Spend / Mobile app purchases; verified currency/event.

Cost per mobile app install.text: Spend / Mobile app installs; verified currency/event.

Leads value.text: No fixed event-value key; bind approved lead monetary value from the actual report/export with matching attribution; unknown if absent.

Purchase ROAS.text: Verified monetary value for the same event as Purchases / Spend; ratio. Event-specific value key is unresolved in the open report schema; never use count as value.

Website purchase ROAS.text: Verified monetary value for the same event as Website purchases / Spend; ratio. Event-specific value key is unresolved in the open report schema; never use count as value.

Mobile app purchase ROAS.text: Verified monetary value for the same event as Mobile app purchases / Spend; ratio. Event-specific value key is unresolved in the open report schema; never use count as value.

ROAS (Leads).text: Verified monetary value for the same event as Leads / Spend; ratio. Event-specific value key is unresolved in the open report schema; never use count as value.

Frequency.text: No typed frequency key; require verified same-scope whole-window report/export frequency.

_clicks.text: TOTAL_CLICKTHROUGH → B.rows[].TOTAL_CLICKTHROUGH; clickthrough count, not all Meta clicks.

_linkClicks.text: OUTBOUND_CLICK_1 → B.rows[].OUTBOUND_CLICK_1; outbound count; confirm this matches the intended link-click definition.

CTR.text: 100 × _clicks / Impressions only for confirmed paid/clickthrough scope; percentage points.

CTR (Link clicks).text: 100 × _linkClicks / Impressions only for matching paid scope; percentage points.

CPC (Link).text: Spend / _linkClicks; currency/outbound click for matching paid scope.

Purchases.text: TOTAL_CHECKOUT → B.rows[].TOTAL_CHECKOUT; checkout across the verified event scope count. Verify attribution, never use mixed TOTAL_CONVERSIONS.

Website purchases.text: TOTAL_WEB_CHECKOUT → B.rows[].TOTAL_WEB_CHECKOUT; website checkout count. Verify attribution, never use mixed TOTAL_CONVERSIONS.

Leads.text: TOTAL_LEAD → B.rows[].TOTAL_LEAD; lead count. Verify attribution, never use mixed TOTAL_CONVERSIONS.

Mobile app purchases.text: No verified app-specific count binding in the current analytics contract; do not substitute total checkouts/conversions. Verify only the relevant event section or obtain matching export.

Mobile app installs.text: No verified app-specific count binding in the current analytics contract; do not substitute total checkouts/conversions. Verify only the relevant event section or obtain matching export.

Cost per purchase.text: Spend / Purchases; currency/event, unknown if the event binding is unavailable.

Cost per website purchase.text: Spend / Website purchases; currency/event, unknown if the event binding is unavailable.

Cost per lead.text: Spend / Leads; currency/event, unknown if the event binding is unavailable.

Cost per mobile app purchase.text: Spend / Mobile app purchases; currency/event, unknown if the event binding is unavailable.

Cost per mobile app install.text: Spend / Mobile app installs; currency/event, unknown if the event binding is unavailable.

Purchase ROAS.text: CHECKOUT_ROAS → B.rows[].CHECKOUT_ROAS; ratio for verified checkout scope/attribution, not a lead/app ratio.

Website purchase ROAS.text: TOTAL_WEB_CHECKOUT_VALUE_IN_MICRO_DOLLAR → B.rows[].TOTAL_WEB_CHECKOUT_VALUE_IN_MICRO_DOLLAR/1000000, divided by Spend; ratio using matching website-checkout attribution.

Leads value.text: No verified lead monetary-value column; use the approved CRM/export value and matching event, currency and attribution. Missing value stays unknown.

Mobile app purchase ROAS.text: No verified app-specific monetary-value binding; require a matching export/value definition, never substitute CHECKOUT_ROAS.

Frequency.text: No frequency/reach column in this contract; require same-window frequency export. Impressions alone cannot establish frequency.

campaign.text: PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_CAMPAIGNS(ad_account_id): B.items[].daily_spend_cap/1000000, account-currency daily cap; lifetime_spend_cap is different. A cap is not automatically an allocated daily budget.

adset.text: PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_AD_GROUPS(ad_account_id): B.items[].budget_in_micro_currency/1000000, account currency; budget_type must be DAILY.

ad.text: No ad-owned budget; resolve the intended owner with the user.

selected.text: Resolve campaign cap versus ad-group budget ownership before comparison.

Bid amount.text: PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_AD_GROUPS(ad_account_id): B.items[].bid_in_micro_currency/1000000; currency per billable_event. Verify bidding applicability; no bid write tool.

Hours since creation.text: Use the matching PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_CAMPAIGNS/LIST_AD_GROUPS/LIST_ADS(ad_account_id): B.items[].created_time is Unix time; (now−created_time)/3600 hours.

Ads in ad set.text: PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_ADS(ad_account_id): count unique B.items[].id under the exact ad_group_id; page through has_more/next_cursor.

Active ads in ad set.text: PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_ADS(ad_account_id): count unique B.items[].id under the exact ad_group_id; filter agreed status/summary_status; page through has_more/next_cursor.

Active ad sets in campaign.text: PINTEREST_ADS_LIST_AD_GROUPS(ad_account_id): count unique B.items[].id under the exact campaign_id; filter agreed status/summary_status; page through has_more/next_cursor.

Notify.text: Return matching values here; external delivery requires the user-selected destination and sending capability.

Duplicate.text: No verified exact-duplication binding for this target. Preserve source/copy count and let the user choose manual duplication or another supported operation; creation alone is not duplication.
